decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the listed buildings, or the removal of any external/ internal feature, except so far as the alteration hereby approved necessitates the removal of certain parts of the listed buildings. All damage shall be made good in accordance with the character of the listed buildings.
description: Demolition of link corridor in between building 4 and 44 Cavalry Barracks.
